intent: single-phase water flow on a 100 m cube, run for 1 year with VTK output monthly

cases.name: negative_pressure
cases.mutation: Set the Constitutive referencePressure attributes to -100 (negative; below the 0 Pa floor). Caught by sanity_check's pressure_positive rule.
cases.note: Plan originally specified perm_out_of_range, but sanity_check cannot parse the GEOS list literal in permeabilityComponents (it float()s the value), so an out-of-range permeability is NOT tool-catchable in this codebase. Negative reference pressure is a scalar the rule does parse, so it is a genuinely tool-catchable physics defect. See tests/review/RUNBOOK.md and agents4geos sanity-rule notes.

cases.name: broken_materiallist_ref
cases.mutation: Change one name in an ElementRegion materialList to a constitutive model name that does not exist (e.g. 'nonexistentRock').

cases.name: duration_mismatch
cases.mutation: Set Events maxTime to 2.6e6 (about 1 month) while the intent says 1 year. Deck stays schema-valid.
